boards.title: 10 Late-Night Runs That Explain Emerson College
boards.description: Ten under-21-safe food, dessert, and supply stops with documented late hours, ranging from Emerson’s own campus market to nearby Theatre District and Boston destinations.

cards.title: Tacos Until 2 A.M.
cards.subtitle: 80 Boylston Street, beside Emerson’s Boston campus
cards.notes: Check the live location hours, then walk to the Boylston Street storefront for tacos, burritos, bowls, or a late dinner to go.
cards.short_summary: A campus-edge taqueria with documented service until 2 a.m. every day.
cards.evidence_claim: El Jefe’s official website lists its Boston Common restaurant at 80 Boylston Street and states that it operates daily from 8 a.m. to 2 a.m.
cards.source_title: El Jefe’s Taqueria | Authentic Mexican Food. Open Til 4AM.
cards.access_notes: The official location listing shows 8 a.m.–2 a.m. seven days a week; confirm same-day service before leaving campus.

cards.title: The Tremont Street Pizza Window
cards.subtitle: 224 Tremont Street in the Theatre District
cards.notes: Walk down Tremont Street and consult the day-specific schedule before ordering; Thursday through Saturday carry the latest posted closing.
cards.short_summary: A nearby pizzeria whose official schedule extends to 3 a.m. on three nights.
cards.evidence_claim: New York Pizza’s official Theatre District page lists 224 Tremont Street and hours until 1 a.m. Sunday through Wednesday and 3 a.m. Thursday through Saturday.
cards.access_notes: Official hours run to 1 a.m. Sunday–Wednesday and 3 a.m. Thursday–Saturday; check for holiday changes.

cards.title: Dumplings After Midnight
cards.subtitle: 695 Washington Street in Chinatown
cards.notes: Continue toward Chinatown and check the official schedule first; Friday and Saturday offer the latest documented ordering window.
cards.short_summary: A Chinatown dumpling destination with weekend hours extending past 1 a.m.
cards.evidence_claim: Dumpling Cafe’s direct ordering site identifies the restaurant at 695 Washington Street and lists Friday and Saturday service until 1:30 a.m.
cards.source_title: Dumpling Cafe - Boston | Location and Hours
cards.access_notes: The direct location page lists 11 a.m.–1:30 a.m. Friday and Saturday and 11 or 11:30 p.m. closings on other nights.

cards.title: The All-Night Diner Run
cards.subtitle: 178 Kneeland Street near South Station
cards.notes: Use well-lit main streets toward Kneeland Street, verify conditions before departing, and choose the diner when other kitchens have closed.
cards.short_summary: A classic diner whose own site explicitly documents continuous 24/7 operation.
cards.evidence_claim: South Street Diner’s official late-night page gives its address as 178 Kneeland Street and states that it is open 24 hours a day, seven days a week.
cards.source_title: South Street Diner - Boston’s Only Late Night Eats
cards.access_notes: The restaurant’s official page states that it is open 24/7; verify weather and walking conditions before making the trip.

cards.title: A South End Kebab Run
cards.subtitle: 145 East Berkeley Street in the South End
cards.notes: Check the restaurant’s live ordering status, then head southwest for Turkish and Middle Eastern takeout during its posted late window.
cards.short_summary: A South End restaurant with takeout hours documented through 2 a.m.
cards.evidence_claim: Ali Baba’s direct location and ordering page lists 145 East Berkeley Street and takeout service until 2 a.m. on its posted schedule.
cards.source_title: Ali Baba Locations | Pickup or Delivery Available
cards.access_notes: The direct ordering page posts takeout through 2 a.m.; use its live open/closed indicator to confirm service before traveling.

cards.title: Burgers on Dartmouth Street
cards.subtitle: 145 Dartmouth Street near Back Bay Station
cards.notes: Check the official day-specific schedule and take Boylston Street west; Friday and Saturday extend two hours beyond the weekday close.
cards.short_summary: A Back Bay burger counter open until midnight or later throughout the week.
cards.evidence_claim: Tasty Burger’s official Back Bay page lists 145 Dartmouth Street and hours until midnight Sunday through Thursday and 2 a.m. Friday and Saturday.
cards.source_title: Back Bay | Hours + Location | Tasty Burger
cards.access_notes: Official hours are 11 a.m.–midnight Sunday–Thursday and 11 a.m.–2 a.m. Friday–Saturday; confirm before departure.

cards.title: Cookies on Clarendon Street
cards.subtitle: 222 Clarendon Street in Back Bay
cards.notes: Head toward Clarendon Street for a dessert-focused run, checking the bakery’s ordering page for live availability before setting out.
cards.short_summary: A late-night bakery documented through midnight or 1 a.m., depending on the day.
cards.evidence_claim: Insomnia Cookies’ official Back Bay announcement identifies 222 Clarendon Street and lists midnight closings Sunday through Wednesday and 1 a.m. Thursday through Saturday.
cards.source_title: Insomnia Cookies Opens Fourth Boston Location
cards.access_notes: The official store announcement posts midnight closings Sunday–Wednesday and 1 a.m. Thursday–Saturday; recheck live ordering hours.

cards.title: A Round-the-Clock Bakery
cards.subtitle: 134 Salem Street in the North End
cards.notes: Plan the longer North End trip with a companion, use main streets, and confirm conditions even though the bakery documents continuous operation.
cards.short_summary: A named North End bakery whose official history page states it never closes.
cards.evidence_claim: Bova’s Bakery’s official site gives its address as 134 Salem Street and states that the family bakery is open 24 hours a day, every day.
cards.access_notes: The bakery’s official page states it is open 24 hours every day; account for the longer walk from Emerson and verify conditions.

cards.title: The On-Campus 2 A.M. Option
cards.subtitle: Inside Piano Row on Emerson’s Boston campus
cards.notes: Use this campus stop for snacks, groceries, coffee, or grill items; check Emerson dining notices because academic breaks can alter access.
cards.short_summary: Emerson’s own convenience market, with a recent college notice identifying 2 a.m. as its normal close.
cards.evidence_claim: Emerson identifies C-Store at the Max as a market and café inside Piano Row, while a January 2026 college notice gives normal Max Cafe hours as 11 a.m. to 2 a.m.
cards.source_title: Winter Storm; Tuesday Schedule Changes for Boston Campus
cards.access_notes: Emerson’s January 2026 notice identifies normal Max Cafe hours as 11 a.m.–2 a.m.; campus access and break schedules may differ.

cards.title: The 24-Hour Supply Run
cards.subtitle: 587 Boylston Street near Copley Square
cards.notes: Use the retail store for packaged food or practical supplies, and note that its pharmacy counter follows shorter hours than the main store.
cards.short_summary: A Boylston Street retail stop whose store and photo departments operate continuously.
cards.evidence_claim: CVS’s official Boston locator lists the store at 587 Boylston Street and marks its store and photo services as open 24 hours.
cards.source_title: CVS Pharmacy Locations in Boston, Massachusetts
cards.access_notes: The official CVS locator marks the store and photo department open 24 hours; the pharmacy counter closes earlier and has separate hours.
